effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 Digimon may gain ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) until the end of your opponent's turn. Then, if DigiXrosing, this Digimon gets +3000 DP and ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, return 1 yellow Digimon card from this Digimon's digivolution cards to the hand.
